title: Verified responsibility per usage
summary: A descriptive metric for the amount of contract-governed responsibility verified per usage unit; it is not a token, price, currency or performance promise.
preconditions: Usage data and verified responsibility have independent provenance.
procedure: Record verified surfaces and their evidence.
Record usage only from an approved operator measurement.
Keep missing or incomparable values null.
Report the metric descriptively without converting it to money or tokens.
decision_rules: A documented surface counts only when its evidence and owner are explicit.
Do not compare windows separated by a reset as one uninterrupted scale.
stop_conditions: Stop if usage, quota or responsibility data is reconstructed from memory or mixed across incompatible windows.
validation: Macro 03 execution metric preserves operator-reported provenance and reset quality.
failure_modes: Turning an internal descriptive measure into a commercial claim.
Hiding uncertainty in quota or responsibility counts.
recovery: Mark the measurement unavailable or reset-interrupted and preserve the raw operator report.

evidence_refs.claim: Macro 02.2 preserves exact suite and publication evidence.
Operator-reported values remain descriptive and reset-aware.

confidence.rationale: Candidate metric pattern with no field or commercial validation.
